(2) The scene shifts to the man wearing a black baseball cap and a white sweatshirt, holding a young toddler girl in a floral-patterned dress. The man's facial expression is serious and focused. (3) Multiple quick cuts show the man in a striped black-and-white shirt and later a green knit sweater, repeatedly using tissues on his nose. (7) The final scene shows the whole family—a woman and three children—at a large dining table filled with food. They all wave or give thumbs-up gestures toward the camera. Probiotic boxes are placed prominently on the table. The lighting is warm and domestic, suggesting a healthy family mealtime.
